order: This work builds the Quartermaster's own deterministic P0 substrate. Recorded allowance readings go in, and the router's bucket-state shape comes out, so the module has to carry zero dependencies and stay plain CommonJS, mirroring the existing verifier and router substrates that are already fully in place. Its state must derive only from real recorded readings across both vendors, never a fabricated denominator, while ledger attribution stays out of scope entirely, since it is impossible today and remains a registered follow-on. The allGreen function stays exported as a test affordance, and the router's own scoring module stays untouched, so nothing downstream has to change. No registry schema gets added, since the entry contract belongs in this module's own file and nowhere else, and the two new runtime data files get ignored so they stay out of every commit. Interop then gets proven end to end against the real router, wired into the pipeline right after it.
claims: A compact deterministic module shipped alongside a matching suite of 152 checks, run against temp-directory fixtures so the project data files are never touched. Interop was proven against the live router: a green state dispatches end to end, a below-reserve reading fires the reserve gate, and an unconfirmed arm fires while a recorded confirmation lifts it again. A hard throttle takes the exhaustion recast, and an exhausted bucket keeps mandatory review from closing. The pipeline now runs this suite right after the router's, and the runtime files stay out of version control.
